CommunityApplications.Profile:
unraid-apps is the Community Applications template repository for ggardenhire's self-hosted applications. It is the single place Unraid pulls Docker templates from; each app's source code lives in its own repository.
Applications maintained here:
- curtain - a public-facing, read-only dashboard for your Unraid server (live metrics, storage breakdown, quick links). https://github.com/ggardenhire/curtain - podium - a thin, self-updating static-site runner that clones, builds and serves GitHub repos and redeploys on push. https://github.com/ggardenhire/podium
For help, bug reports, or feature requests, open an issue on the relevant project repository linked above.
